draft.subject: A hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Following up on my last note — you've got your first project going, which is the main thing. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks there is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Timber Works works. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your next step with you, or just answer questions by email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
